headlines.title: Why Eurasia, Not the Indo-Pacific, Matters Most in Next Phase of Taiwan Deterrence
Trump set for Washington summit with Xi focused on trade, Taiwan and AI
U.S backs Taiwan’s continued PIF role, warns of China’s ‘malign activities’ in Pacific
Taiwan Stock Market Due For Profit Taking
New Zealand naval ships transit contested Taiwan Strait

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
New Zealand naval ships transited the contested Taiwan Strait. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR TAIWAN
The transit of New Zealand naval ships through the Taiwan Strait underscores ongoing international naval presence in the waterway. [5]

KEY RISKS
The Taiwan stock market is due for profit taking, suggesting potential short-term market correction. [4]
